content.text: Instructor Christopher Muscato Show bioChris has a master's degree in history and teaches at the University of Northern Colorado. Historical Context of Australia's Ethnic Makeup Australia became a British colony in the 18th Century. Because of this, many early settlers were English prisoners sent for rehabilitation. These English settlers became the dominant group over time. Today, most Australians still identify with their English heritage. Ethnic Groups in Australia The majority of Australians' ethnicity is white, with around 85-90% having European ancestry. Among them, 26% identify as English, 8% as Irish, 3% as Italian, 3% as German, 2% as Greek, and 1% as Dutch. Another 25% identify simply as white Australians. This is similar to how some Americans identify as white Americans. The country's Asian population has grown in recent years. About 3% of Australians identify as Chinese, while the rest come from different parts of Asia. A national migration program launched in the 1940s brought more diversity. Since then, over 6 million immigrants have moved to Australia. Indigenous Population Before British colonization, Australia was home to many Indigenous groups, including Aboriginal peoples. Colonialism, disease, and warfare significantly reduced their population. Now, only about 1% of the population identifies as Aboriginal. Some, however, identify as having mixed Aboriginal heritage, and this number has slowly grown in recent years. Impact of Migration and Diversity As mentioned, the migration program in the 1940s brought over 6 million new residents to Australia from around the world. Today, 25% of Australians were born overseas, and about 33% have at least one parent born in another country. This mix of cultures has shaped Australian society. Over 200 languages are spoken across the country. Diverse cuisine options also reflect this international culture. Despite its high diversity, Australia shows low levels of social prejudice. Hence, the country is often described as a unique, multicultural society.
